newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Hyundai shuts cracker due to gas leak.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Hyundai shuts cracker due to gas leak.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Petrochemical Co, an affiliate of Hyundai Group, has closed down its naphtha cracker due to a gas leak at one of its small tanks, company officials said on Friday.
The 450,000 tonnes-a-year unit, which was shut down on Tuesday, is expected to be back up on Saturday, they said.
"We spotted a small gas leak at one of our tanks and closed the naphtha cracker down," one company official told Reuters by telephone.
"We expect the unit to resume operation tomorrow," he said.
He said the company had bought 3,000 tonnes of ethylene from China to meet a shortage of supply due to the closure.
